CHANGE_CLASS: Durable, tested, line-resumable process engineering — the one and only class of change permitted by the owner reauthorization. No scientific file was touched; FCDDH01R_SCIENTIFIC_OBJECT_IDENTITY_MANIFEST.json re-verified with zero drift (13 byte-identical modules + 1 declared trainer line).
EVIDENCE_PATH_NOTE: The generation-2 campaign is committed under DEX_FAILURE_INJECTION_EVIDENCE_GEN2/ rather than overwriting the generation-1 directory. Git here is append-only and the device mount refuses deletions, so merging two campaigns into one path would have produced a directory that is neither campaign. fr_dex.py still writes to DEX_FAILURE_INJECTION_EVIDENCE/ at run time; the GEN2 suffix exists only in the committed tree.
REASON: Remedy of the latent line-resumability defect recorded in FCDDH01R_WAL_MONOTONICITY_ADJUDICATION.json.

TEST_EVIDENCE.dex_campaign: 20/20 PASS, zero engine starts, dummy engine-free

run_id_impact: NONE. PhaseLedger.run_id is a function of (programme, phase, execution_class, ordinal, operator_hash, input_hashes, schedule_position). The executor code hash is recorded in the plan for audit but does not enter any run_id, so no already-charged row changes identity and no completed phase can be silently re-entered under a new identity.
substantive_changes: PhaseLedger.publish_raw split into seal_output (emits RAW_SEALED) and publish_sealed (emits RAW_PUBLISHED). Neither emits the row-terminal VERIFIED.

DURABLE_PHASE_SUPERVISOR._publish_all now seals EVERY declared output, then publishes EVERY declared output, then emits exactly one row-terminal VERIFIED. A row can no longer carry a terminal state while one of its own declared outputs is unpublished.
fr_dummy.py gained an optional --second output so multi-output rows can be exercised without an engine. Its import set is unchanged: hashlib, json, os, sys, time.
New DEX cases 17, 18, 19 covering the publication window, multi-output monotonicity, and the seal-all/publish-all boundary.
DEX12 assertion tightened to the corrected contract: publication alone no longer terminates a row; SKIP_VERIFIED requires the row-terminal record.
DEX4 fixed-3s sleep replaced by a bounded 45 s poll. The invariant always held; the assertion was load-dependent. Confirmed by the refusal marker written after the old window closed.
